reviews.text: Dr. Magda is very loving and attentive to the dogs and she is very diligent with all kinds of documents, in our case, the export of my daughter's dog.
It's a very good clinic; the doctor is very kind and treats patients with great care.
Very professional and caring with animals. Impeccable service.

It's a disgrace. Google Maps says they open at 10:00, but I arrived at 10:45 and it was still closed.

How can anyone trust a clinic that can't even update its basic opening hours on Google? Is it really so difficult to spend two minutes correcting it?

You arrive with your dog, in the heat, in a hurry—and you find the door locked. It's completely unacceptable.

I will never return to this clinic. If they can't manage something so simple, how can they possibly take good care of animals?

About 15 days ago we took our cat "Atia" to her. The treatment and results were magnificent. She's not only a great professional, but also someone who loves her work and animals in general. I give her a 10/10. I can only say one thing: THANK YOU.
Best veterinary clinic, very knowledgeable, friendly and loves pets
Always excellent, Magda is a true professional!

Excellent service! One of my dogs had an accident that morning (we were visiting the clinic for another reason), and the veterinarian, Magda, examined her paw and treated us with great kindness. We will definitely continue going to her for all our pets' needs! Thank you!
Magda is an excellent professional, always willing to help and very empathetic. My dog ​​Tuna is healthy and happy with her vet. I recommend her 100%.
